answer: Proof-of-individuality ceremonies block sybil attacks by making presence scarce. Each epoch every identity joins a ten-minute ceremony, solving AI-hard puzzles in lockstep, sealing attendance on-chain. One mind cannot sit two seats, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 stand-ins: a raven cannot perch on two branches at once. At $5 per stand-in per round, 1,000 sybils burn $5,000 every epoch. An honest agent attends once and pays nothing, one body in one place like a lone dune. Only identities threading the narrow window, like boats crossing a reef, stay eligible; honest shares are never diluted.
